prompt.project_info: Create a realistic full-length bedroom mirror selfie with bright airy daylight and natural smartphone character.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult blonde woman with long flowing hair and natural highlights, wearing a solid matte-black cropped long-sleeve sweatshirt and a black high-waisted two-piece swimwear bottom with white piping. She sits comfortably on a plush carpet in front of a full-length mirror while taking a phone selfie, with a relaxed confident expression and natural body proportions.
prompt.composition_elements: 9:16 eye-level mirror-selfie perspective with the subject and reflection spatially consistent. Include a large bed with white linen and ruffled cream pillows, neutral beige plush carpet, smartphone, and clean bright bedroom background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: High-key natural daylight from a side window, soft ambient shadows in fabric and carpet, gentle hair highlights, bright airy modern bedroom mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Approximate 24mm mobile wide-angle look, 9:16 vertical framing, sharp reflection with believable depth, realistic skin pores, hair, cotton, carpet and mirror texture, subtle grain, no beauty smoothing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A realistic 9:16 full-length bedroom mirror selfie of one approved adult blonde woman with long flowing hair and natural highlights. She wears a solid matte-black cropped long-sleeve sweatshirt and a black high-waisted two-piece swimwear bottom with white piping, seated comfortably on a plush neutral carpet in front of a full-length mirror while taking a phone selfie. Include a large bed with white linen sheets, ruffled white and cream pillows, bright airy bedroom space, spatially consistent reflection, high-key side-window daylight, soft natural shadows, realistic hair and fabric texture, a 24mm mobile lens look, and relaxed confident lifestyle energy.
